summary: After creating each component's user and database, add the connection details under `[all:vars]`: `pg_host`, `pg_database`, `pg_port`, `pg_username`, `pg_password` for controller, and the same with `automationgateway_pg_`, `automationhub_pg_` and `automationedacontroller_pg_` prefixes for gateway, hub and EDA.
questions: Which inventory variables configure an external database in AAP RPM?
How do I point platform gateway at an external database?

answer_card.title: External database inventory variables (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[all:vars]
pg_host=data.example.com
pg_database=<db>
pg_port=5432
pg_username=<user>
pg_password=<password>

automationgateway_pg_host=...       # same five with each prefix:
automationhub_pg_host=...           # automationgateway_pg_*
automationedacontroller_pg_host=... # automationhub_pg_*, automationedacontroller_pg_*
```
